ld.What is the cheapest water activity in F: Kayak and paddleboard rentals start from $4–$15 per hour. Jet ski tours start around $99. Boat rentals from $260. Use the price filter on our homepage to find activities within any budget.
ld.Do I need a license to rent a jet ski in: Anyone born after January 1, 1988 must complete a boating safety course and carry a Florida Boating Safety Education ID card. Most rental operators provide a brief safety orientation. Captained charters are available if you prefer not to drive.
ld.What is the best time of year for water: Miami water sports are available year-round. Peak season is November–April with calmer seas and pleasant temperatures. Summer (June–September) is warmest but afternoon storms are common. Most operators run 7 days a week from 8am–6pm.
